correctness.rationale: Ordering three independent uniform angles has density 6/L³ in coordinates u=θ1, s=θ3-θ1, t=θ2-(θ1+θ3)/2. The shoelace identity A=sin(s/2)(cos t-cos(s/2)) gives exact finite-threshold arccos integral and optimizer s*=min(L,4π/3). For L<4π/3, deficit p_L(L-s)+q_L t² plus available u-length L-s yields exponent 5/2 and exact coefficient 16/(5L³ p_L² sqrt(q_L)); at L=4π/3 quadratic δ²+t² with δ factor yields 3/2 and 18/(3^(3/4)π³); above it the equilateral-optimizer interval of length L-4π/3 and an elliptic disk yield linear 16π(L-4π/3)/L³. Independently confirmed critical and orbit coefficients symbolically. Compact localization and integrable Jacobian weights yield conditional total variation of the specified Dirichlet/uniform marks; not merely moment convergence. Finite checker inspected as corroboration only.
